scope: United States federal AI acquisition oversight, selected four-agency GAO review
dataUse: Factual extracts and original summaries from US GAO-authored federal report only; no third-party graphics or bulk reproduced text. Verify separately copyrighted elements before reuse.
causality: The selected sample and policy deficiencies do not establish misconduct, failed procurements, financial losses, or changes in public trust.

sources.permission: US federal government-authored factual findings; third-party content excluded

observations.measure: Federal agencies selected for AI acquisition review
observations.population: DOD, DHS, GSA and VA; purposively selected, not representative of all federal agencies
Selected AI acquisitions at DOD, DHS, GSA and VA
observations.note: Not a count of failed procurements.

observations.measure: Reviewed agencies whose officials reported policies did not require systematic collection of AI acquisition lessons learned
observations.population: Four selected federal agencies (DOD, DHS, GSA, VA)
observations.note: Agency policy gap; not proof of misconduct or bad outcomes.

observations.measure: GAO recommendations to establish systematic AI acquisition lessons-learned processes
observations.population: One recommendation each to DOD, DHS, GSA and VA
observations.note: All four agencies concurred at publication; concurrence is not implementation.

events.subject: GAO review of federal AI acquisitions
events.finding: Four selected agencies lacked policies requiring systematic collection of lessons learned from AI acquisitions.
events.disposition: GAO issued four recommendations; all four agencies concurred at report publication. Do not equate concurrence with closure.
